premises.text: Priorities come from email, mind, and meetings and must be captured, triaged, planned, and done in one trusted system—the handle habit
premises.evidence_span: email clients have not been able to solve this problem alone, and task managers have not been able to solve this problem alone

premises.text: Handle Mobile captures thoughts and shows priorities away from the desk
premises.evidence_span: when I'm away from my desk, I can keep an eye on my priorities

premises.text: A keyboard-driven handlebar triage engine lets users archive, reply, task, unsubscribe, and push email as fast as they think
premises.evidence_span: we've created a unique element we call the handlebar

premises.text: A priority list ordered by importance supports snooze and calendar time-blocking so users execute must-dos with full task context
premises.evidence_span: Handle's priority list is ordered by importance with must dos at the top

value.text: People get their most important must-do work done that day and protect life outcomes beyond the inbox
value.evidence_span: getting all the must do things you have to do done that day

causal_links.evidence_span: We call this the handle habit
